name: dsh-plugin-plan
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：dsh-plugin-plan。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use as the planning stage of dsh-plugin-development, or when asked to design a standalone DSH Cordis plugin without implementing it. Decide plugin form, roles, dependencies, configuration, invariant ownership, profile composition, evidence, and distribution before files are copied or code is written.
